chunks: And whatever is in it from Jaʿfar ibn al-Qasim, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥya; and Aḥmad ibn Idris, all from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allah, from his father, from Jaʿfar ibn al-Qasim.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jaʿfar ibn al-Qasim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage states the transmission chain through which the author narrates reports from Jaʿfar ibn al-Qasim. It serves as a sanad clarification in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the author’s route of transmission through named teachers and transmitters.
